rows.text: calls `00225C40 + 0x2D` with (qword `+0x210` of `rcx` == 0), then `00584740(0x50)`; when that is non-null calls `00225C40 + 0x47` on it and keeps the result, else keeps 0; stores the kept pointer to qword `+0x210` of `rcx` (the old value is not released) and byte 2 to its `+0x38` (no null check), then copies the zero-terminated byte string at `rdx`, terminator included, to `rcx + 0x10`

notes: FABLE w5-3 draft. Calls to callees the page context does not name are cited by call site (`<entry> + 0xNN`).
